articles._summary: Two of America’s largest companies reported earnings this week. Neither was punished for what it sold . Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) lost $294 billion in market value on Thursday, the largest single-session loss in the company’s history. Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ: TSLA ) suffered its worst week since March 2020. articles._summary: The U.S. ETF industry’s hottest product is no longer just a blockbuster fund, it’s the copycat. A record 1,084 ETFs had launched by mid-July, already within striking distance of 2025’s full-year record of 1,161, per Morningstar. With U.S.-listed ETF inflows on pace to reach $2.3 trillion this year, as estimated by State Street, issuers are racing to capture the next winning investment theme before rivals do. And interestingly, a successful ETF doesn’t just attract assets, it spawns an entire category.

articles._zh_summary: 美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）股价在周五盘前交易中下跌超过 1%，尽管大盘走强，但交易员锁定了存储芯片股票的涨幅。美光科技在过去 12 个月中飙升了 786.25%，交易价格接近 52 周区间的顶部，这一位置可能会在强劲上涨后引发获利了结或一段时间的盘整。美光科技仍处于混合技术结构中。

articles.author: Surbhi Jain
articles.headline: Tesla Just Had a Toyota-Sized Meltdown—JPMorgan, UBS Raise Red Flags
articles.summary: Tesla erased $214.5 billion in market value after earnings. JPMorgan and UBS cut price targets as investors question profits and AI spending.
articles._summary: The stock plunged 14.52% to close at $319.69—the largest one-day loss in Tesla’s history. Trading volume surged to 115.61 million shares, more than double its three-month daily average of 49.4 million shares. Tesla’s second-quarter results gave investors multiple reasons to hit the sell button. While revenue topped Wall Street estimates, adjusted earnings of 33 cents per share fell well short of expectations as automotive margins deteriorated.
articles._zh_headline: 特斯拉刚刚经历了丰田规模的崩溃——摩根大通、瑞银发出危险信号
articles._zh_summary: 该股暴跌 14.52%，收于 319.69 美元，创下特斯拉历史上最大单日跌幅。交易量激增至 11561 万股，是三个月日均交易量 4940 万股的两倍多。特斯拉第二季度的业绩给投资者提供了多种卖出按钮的理由。尽管营收超出华尔街预期，但由于汽车利润率恶化，调整后每股收益 33 美分远低于预期。
